# Magnus Path

> Magnus Path is an e-commerce marketing agency based in Chennai, India. One team builds e-commerce websites (Shopify, WooCommerce, custom), runs e-commerce ads (Amazon, Flipkart, Meta, Google, Blinkit/Zepto/Instamart) and delivers e-commerce SEO (store SEO, marketplace SEO, AI search optimisation) for brands in India, the UK, UAE, Australia and the USA.

## Services
- [E-commerce Website Development](https://www.magnuspath.com/ecommerce-website-development/)
- [Shopify Development](https://www.magnuspath.com/shopify-development/)
- [Amazon Advertising Agency](https://www.magnuspath.com/amazon-marketing-agency/)
- [Amazon Account Management](https://www.magnuspath.com/amazon-account-management/)
- [Flipkart Account Management](https://www.magnuspath.com/flipkart-account-management/)
- [E-commerce SEO Services](https://www.magnuspath.com/ecommerce-seo/)
- [B2B Digital Marketing for Manufacturers & Exporters](https://www.magnuspath.com/b2b-digital-marketing/)
